# stats-wells: `WellStatsOutput`

The `data` payload of `openreadout stats PLATE --per well --json` (also the MCP tool `openreadout_stats` with `per: "well"`), inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `stats --per well` and MCP `openreadout_stats` with `per: "well"`.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/stats-wells.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/stats-wells.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema stats-wells`.

## Fields

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | The input file. |
| `format` | `string` | yes | Format id of the input file. |
| `plate` | `string` or `null` |  | Plate id or barcode, when recorded. |
| `level` | `integer` (uint32) |  | Pyramid level read (0 = full resolution); omitted when 0. |
| `select` | array of `string` | yes | The selection as given; empty = every plane. |
| `per_field` | `boolean` | yes | True when rows are per field of view. |
| `columns` | array of `string` | yes | Column names of `rows`, in order (for tables and CSV). |
| `rows` | array of [`WellStatsRow`](#wellstatsrow) | yes | One row per (well, channel), or per (well, field, channel) with `per_field`, in plate order (row by row, then field, then channel). |
| `wells_without_data` | array of `string` |  | Selected wells without a single readable plane (every file missing). |
| `notes` | array of `string` |  | Things to know when reading the rows (absent planes left out, missing files skipped). |

## Types

### WellStatsRow

One tidy row of [`WellStatsOutput`]: the statistics of one channel over the selected planes
of one well (or one field of it).

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plate` | `string` or `null` |  | Plate id or barcode, when recorded (the same on every row). |
| `well` | `string` | yes | Well name (`C05`). |
| `row` | `string` | yes | Row letters. |
| `column` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Column number, 1-based. |
| `image` | `integer` (uint32) or `null` |  | Per-field rows only: the image index of the field. |
| `field` | `integer` (uint32) or `null` |  | Per-field rows only: the field number as the acquisition software counts it. |
| `c` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Channel index. |
| `channel` | `string` or `null` |  | Channel name, if recorded. |
| `fields` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Fields of view whose planes were read into this row. |
| `planes` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Planes aggregated. |
| `planes_missing` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Selected planes whose files are missing (skipped). |
| `count` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Finite samples. |
| `mean` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Mean intensity (absent when no plane was read). |
| `std` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Population standard deviation. |
| `min` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Smallest sample. |
| `max` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Largest sample. |
| `p1` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | 1st percentile (NumPy `linear` interpolation). |
| `median` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Median. |
| `p99` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | 99th percentile. |
| `zero_fraction` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Fraction of samples equal to 0. |
| `saturated_fraction` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Integer data: fraction of samples at the type's maximum (detector saturation). |
